sources.title: Molecular jumps: acquired-certificate safety over exponential finite horizons (N35)
sources.use: Separates the finite-horizon safety theorem under an acquired inward-polytope certificate from global stochastic recovery, nonexplosion, and ergodicity.

sources.title: Some Network Conditions for Positive Recurrence of Stochastically Modeled Reaction Networks
sources.authors: David F. Anderson and Jinsu Kim
sources.use: Primary prior art for fixed-rate positive recurrence and finite expected entry under structural conditions; does not state this report's arbitrary predictable control quantifier.

sources.title: The finite state projection algorithm for the solution of the chemical master equation
sources.use: Primary prior art for finite-time CME truncation with an accuracy certificate based on probability lost to the absorbing sink. The present derivation supplies an explicit a-priori cutoff for the displayed controlled family.

sources.title: A Lyapunov Approach for Time Bounded Reachability of CTMCs and CTMDPs
sources.authors: Mahmoud Salamati, Sadegh Soudjani, and Rupak Majumdar
sources.use: Primary prior art for Lyapunov-based time-bounded reachability approximation and CTMDP policy synthesis, with queueing examples; the transfer target here is policy-uniform truncation from a countable-state reaction recovery certificate. No priority claim is made.

sources.title: Bounded truncation error for long-run averages in infinite Markov chains
sources.use: Primary prior art for Foster-Lyapunov-based finite truncation error bounds for long-run averages, including queueing performance measures.

sources.title: Robust Stochastic Chemical Reaction Networks and Bounded Tau-Leaping
sources.use: Primary prior art on probability robustness to propensity perturbations, approximate stochastic simulation, and limitations on sublinear-in-time prediction.

sources.title: Tier structure of strongly endotactic reaction networks
sources.authors: D. F. Anderson, J. Cappelletti, J. Kim, and T. D. Nguyen
sources.identifier: Stochastic Processes and their Applications 130 (2020), 7218-7259; arXiv:1808.05328v2
sources.use: Primary context for the strongly-endotactic explosive counterexample and the failure of general deterministic permanence to imply stochastic recurrence.
